summary: Populates a caller-supplied structure with locale-derived string data. Reads two read-only word globals (word_8D3F92, word_8D3F94) into locals typed as LCID, returns -1 when the destination pointer is null, then issues 43 calls to sub_5968F6(1, locale, id, &a1->field) covering destination offsets 0 and 4..168, OR-ing the per-call statuses and returning the accumulated result. sub_5968F6 in mode 1 is the locale-information retriever (per its skeleton fill), so the identifiers passed (in the 0x1F..0x4F range plus 0x1003) are treated as locale-style field keys. Invoked once from PhysicsAllocatorNodeInit (0x0058EF83).

local_names.a1: destination structure receiving one locale field value per call
local_names.v2..v43: accumulated bitwise-OR of sub_5968F6 status results

operations.description: Reads word_8D3F92 into Locale and word_8D3F94 into v44, both as 16-bit values widened to LCID
When the destination pointer a1 is null the function returns -1 immediately

Forty-three calls to sub_5968F6(1, locale, id, &a1->field), one per destination dword at offsets 0 and 4..168, each passing a locale-style identifier (0x1F..0x4F range plus 0x1003) and a destination offset into a1
Accumulates the per-call status of every sub_5968F6 invocation with a bitwise OR chain; a non-zero bit in the result marks at least one field load as failed
Returns the final OR-ed status, or -1 on the null-pointer guard
Invoked by PhysicsAllocatorNodeInit (0x0058EF83) as part of its initialization
